title: Multi-tenant products, with access control underneath
body: Three of these projects separate tenants or roles at the data layer rather than in the interface: row-level security in Supabase, a four-group permission model in Django, per-tenant isolation in the chat platform. Retrofitting that is a rewrite.

title: LLM features that stay grounded and swappable
body: A model is a dependency, not an architecture. The chat platform routes several vendors behind one interface and answers from retrieved documentation; the flashcard tool puts generated cards behind a review gate before a scheduler ever sees them.

title: Edge-first delivery on small runtimes
body: Most of this runs on workers and edge functions rather than a long-lived server: Hono on Cloudflare, Deno on Supabase, front ends on Vercel. Small runtimes keep the cold path cheap and make deployment boring, which is the goal.
